metadata.description: Spec Workflow MCP provides structured spec-driven development with a sequential workflow (Requirements → Design → Tasks), real-time web dashboard, and VSCode extension support. Includes human approval gates at each stage, project steering guidance, and an autonomous SDD harness plugin.

plugins.name: spec-workflow-mcp
plugins.description: MCP server for structured spec-driven development with real-time web dashboard and VSCode extension.

plugins.name: spec-workflow-mcp-with-dashboard
plugins.description: MCP server with auto-started dashboard for structured spec-driven development.

plugins.name: spec-workflow-harness
plugins.description: Autonomous SDD harness: supervisor skill, per-phase orchestrator agents and pinned worker agents. No MCP server; for projects that configure spec-workflow in their own .mcp.json.
